AI pre-marking of writing and speaking for exam prep

Mock IELTS or CEFR essays and speaking recordings come back with a band estimate and comments in minutes, and the teacher only checks and signs off. An MVP in 4–7 weeks, from UZS 60 mln; the full version in 10–16 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

Integrations

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Writing Task 1 and 2 and speaking Parts 1 to 3 marked against the public band descriptors
  • Speech-to-text for recordings
  • Teacher review screen with edits
  • Result card to the student in Telegram
  • Calibration on 50 to 100 scripts your teachers already marked
What the full version adds
  • Handwritten scripts read from photos
  • National certificate and CEFR formats
  • Progress per student and group
  • Homework mode with instant feedback
  • Report on teacher hours saved
  • Parent view
Please note

AI marks are estimates and the teacher sets the final mark. Accuracy is measured against your teachers' marks before launch. It is not an official IELTS result.

What we need from you

  • Sample data: questions, documents or chats
  • Answer rules and topics to avoid
  • A person who checks the results
